scope: Generated-data library evaluation; not real-world efficacy or thesis acceptance
threshold_rule: strict score > empirical calibration quantile ceil((1-alpha)*n)
selection: Training and calibration contain only exact-oracle-confirmed correct executions; no labels/fault IDs/expected or peer outputs in profile
partitions: Independent deterministic seeds per workload/split/index; unique source hashes checked; test never used to tune features/thresholds/models
normal_distributions: 256..1024 rows; identity null probability U(.05,.20); 8..24 groups; per-group discount 500..1500bp; integer cents
shifted_normal_distribution: 4096..8192 rows; identity null probability U(.35,.45); 40..64 groups; same correct transformation
claims: Per-workload/fault recall, FPR and unavailable coverage; Wilson95 intervals conditional on this generator and fixed model. Shifted correct cases reported separately. No acceptance score threshold or best-seed selection.
cost_scope: Wall clock per native execution/materialization, profile extraction and Python exact labeling; fit/calibration/batch inference separately; generation/import/file cleanup excluded. Not an end-to-end production latency guarantee.
